title: Browser Text To Speech TTS Realtime
one_liner: A zero-server, client-side neural text-to-speech engine using WebAssembly and ONNX for real-time streaming audio.
what_it_is: This project is a high-performance React application that performs neural text-to-speech synthesis entirely in the browser. It leverages VITS models compiled to WebAssembly via ONNX Runtime, enabling offline-capable, privacy-first audio generation with multi-core parallel processing and streaming playback without external API dependencies.
how_its_built: The frontend is built with React 18, TypeScript, and Vite, styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. The core inference engine uses @diffusionstudio/vits-web to load ONNX models into WebAssembly. Audio processing utilizes Web Workers for multi-threading, while state management relies on React hooks and TanStack Query for data handling. The server component is minimal, primarily serving static assets with COOP/COEP headers to enable SharedArrayBuffer for WASM threads.
how_to_apply: Integrate the useTTS hook into any React component to add voice capabilities. Configure voice ID, speed, and volume via options. Use the speak method to trigger audio generation from text strings, leveraging built-in sentence splitting for streaming playback. Monitor progress via returned state properties like isGenerating and chunks to update UI indicators.
quickstart:
git clone https://github.com/davidbmar/Browser-Text-to-Speech-TTS-Realtime.git
cd Browser-Text-to-Speech-TTS-Realtime
npm install
npm run dev
features: 100% client-side neural TTS using WebAssembly and ONNX
Streaming playback that starts audio before full generation completes
Multi-core processing via WebAssembly threads for faster synthesis
Offline support with browser-cached voice models in IndexedDB
Eight built-in natural voices across English, German, French, and Spanish
Privacy-first architecture with no data sent to external servers
diagram_architecture:
flowchart TD
    User[User Interface]
    ReactApp[React Application]
    UseTTS[useTTS Hook]
    TTSEngine[TTS Engine Class]
    SentenceSplitter[Sentence Splitter]
    ONNXRuntime[ONNX Runtime WASM]
    VoiceModel[Voice Model Cache]
    AudioContext[Web Audio API]
    
    User --> ReactApp
    ReactApp --> UseTTS
    UseTTS --> TTSEngine
    TTSEngine --> SentenceSplitter
    SentenceSplitter --> TTSEngine
    TTSEngine --> ONNXRuntime
    ONNXRuntime --> VoiceModel
    ONNXRuntime --> AudioContext
    AudioContext --> User
diagram_sequence:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant ReactComponent
    participant UseTTS
    participant TTSEngine
    participant ONNXRuntime
    participant AudioAPI
    
    User->>ReactComponent: Click Speak
    ReactComponent->>UseTTS: speak text
    UseTTS->>TTSEngine: process text
    TTSEngine->>TTSEngine: split into sentences
    loop For each sentence
        TTSEngine->>ONNXRuntime: generate audio chunk
        ONNXRuntime->>ONNXRuntime: infer via WASM
        ONNXRuntime-->>TTSEngine: return audio blob
        TTSEngine->>AudioAPI: play chunk
        AudioAPI-->>User: stream audio
    end
    TTSEngine-->>UseTTS: update progress
    UseTTS-->>ReactComponent: update state
